name: `registry`

name: `registry show`
function: Show one designation's full record card.
label: registry show
reuse: any seed needing a filed, searchable asset registry

name: `registry find`
function: Search the registry by designation, name, label, function, or tag.
label: registry find
reuse: any seed needing a filed, searchable asset registry

name: `registry type`
function: List every designation of one type (RM, NPC, CMD...).
label: registry type
reuse: any seed needing a filed, searchable asset registry

name: `registry status`
function: List every designation with one status (active, prototype...).
label: registry status
reuse: any seed needing a filed, searchable asset registry

name: `@sg`
function: System-generate a filed item pattern into the world (wizard+).
label: @sg
reuse: the admin generation verb; every seed inherits it

name: `qa gate`
function: Grade one filed object against the readiness checklist.
label: qa gate
reuse: the global Safety+QA spine; composes with the registry

name: `qa gate all`
function: Grade every filed object (the registry self-audit).
label: qa gate all
reuse: the global Safety+QA spine; composes with the registry

name: `safety review`
function: Rate one object's risk (readiness, not compliance).
label: safety review
reuse: the global Safety+QA spine; composes with the registry

name: `docs check`
function: Sweep the key documentation files for gaps.
label: docs check
reuse: the global Safety+QA spine; composes with the registry

name: `pm status`
function: Project status dashboard, computed from the registry + QualityGate.
label: pm status
reuse: the project control panel; composes registry + QualityGate

name: `pm metrics`
function: Project metrics: objects filed, QA readiness, docs gaps.
label: pm metrics
reuse: the project control panel; composes registry + QualityGate

name: `law`
function: Legal/policy awareness over tracked sources (never legal advice).
label: law
reuse: the compliance-awareness lens over any source registry

name: `truth check`
function: VeritasGate: check that the project's claims match reality.
label: truth check
reuse: the claims-vs-reality gate; composes with any repo's docs+registry

name: `career`
function: Career Evidence Sign: map CodeForge work to job-ready skills with repo proof.
label: career

name: `pioneer`
function: Pioneer Mode: bold-but-honest engineering framework (doctrine, risk ladder, experiments).
label: pioneer

name: `inspect`
function: Inspect the forge: on-demand green/yellow/red frame-up composed from the project's gates.
label: inspect

name: `functions`
function: Hardware Store functions check: run a live demo of each reusable part.
label: functions

name: `terminal`
function: The in-game computer: one console to run every diagnostic program.
label: terminal

name: `blueprint`
function: Blueprint: browse, read, or render a forged plan (idea -> spec -> HTML).
label: blueprint

name: `@forge`
function: the Foundry: propose a part skeleton, approve, and generate it into the sandbox (owner-only).
label: @forge
notes: ADMIN verb, min_rank owner. Two-step: propose (writes nothing) -> approve -> generate into workspace/ sandbox.

name: `@arch`
function: step through the arch into the Proving Ground: review the Foundry's forged candidates (owner, read-only).
label: @arch
notes: ADMIN verb, min_rank owner. Read-only review of the workspace/ sandbox candidates; promotion into parts/ stays a human branch -> PR step.

name: `evolution`
function: Blueprint Evolution Lab, read-only: list and show recorded candidate bake-off runs. Never executes a run or promotes a candidate.
label: evolution
notes: CORE verb. Read-only window on reports/evolution/ runs; producing a run is `make evolution`, never a MUD side effect.

name: `loop trace`
function: Trace a part through every manufacturing stage and file evidence.
label: loop trace
reuse: trace any reusable part through the manufacturing loop

name: `chronicle`
function: The Chronicle, read-only: show the ship's filed memory (newest first), optionally one kind. Never mutates the store.
label: chronicle
notes: CORE verb. Read-only window on the Chronicle ledger; a tampered ledger surfaces its integrity failure rather than crashing the tick.

name: `retention`
function: Retention doctor, read-only: show what the Chronicle keeps, what is eligible for review, and what a hold protects. Never disposes or removes.
label: retention
notes: CORE verb. Read-only R1 doctor over the Chronicle; real disposition arrives owner-gated in R2.

name: `coupling`
function: Engine coupling report, read-only: trace the runtime module closure and list what a runtime cast could shed. Changes nothing (detachment D1).
label: coupling
notes: CORE verb. Read-only D1 report; spawns import-trace subprocesses so it is a few seconds.

name: encounters
function: the after-action log: recent combat encounters and their tallies
label: encounters
notes: Read-only CORE verb rendering parts/encounter_log (the observed leg of the aggression loop). Tick-reachable; renders the bounded ring + tallies, never mutates.

name: use
label: use
notes: CORE verb firing a job's usable ability (parts/world/abilities). A strike reuses combat.land_hit; a heal restores HP; each spends MP. Tick-reachable; refuses no-calling / unknown / wrong-job / no-MP / bad-target.

name: skills
function: list the abilities your calling can wield
label: skills
notes: Read-only CORE verb listing a calling's moveset (parts/world/abilities.render_abilities). Tick-reachable; never mutates.

name: @flush-encounters
function: flush the after-action tallies into the Chronicle as metrics (owner)
label: @flush-encounters
notes: Owner-gated ADMIN verb (the trusted boundary run IN the server process, where the encounter tallies live). Aggregates parts/encounter_log tallies into the Chronicle via parts/encounter_flush; the tick never reaches it. Slice 2 of encounter telemetry (Convergence Review 2026-07-17).

name: join
label: join
notes: The Orders faction join verb (parts/world/orders.swear_order): lists the Row when bare, swears a named hero to an Order and persists it. Refuses unnamed / unknown Order.

name: wallet
label: wallet
notes: Reads session.coins (persisted characters.coins, Alembic a2b8f1e6c04d). Coins are earned per kill (combat._coin_reward: level x tier, levelless foe pays xp//10) and will be spent at shops.

name: shop
label: shop
notes: The shop economy verb (parts/world/shop). Finds the merchant in the player's room.

name: buy
label: buy
notes: The shop economy verb (parts/world/shop). Finds the merchant in the player's room.

name: sell
label: sell
notes: The shop economy verb (parts/world/shop). Finds the merchant in the player's room.

name: quaff
label: quaff
notes: parts/world/consumables.quaff: spend a carried consumable, restore hp/mp.

name: ask
function: ask an NPC about a topic (ask <npc> about <topic>)
label: ask
notes: parts/world/npcs.ask: topic-based conversation over Npc.topics (keyword -> reply lines). Bare `ask <npc>` lists topics. Backward-compatible with `talk` (no-topics NPC has nothing to ask).

name: contracts
label: contracts
notes: quest.contracts_view: lists generated bounty quests + status.

name: survey
function: the Planning Table's world survey (owner, in the Creator's Workshop)
label: survey
notes: First live Creator Workshop station tool: owner-gated AND station-gated (Planning Table). Read-only; composes the live world (rooms/zones/NPCs) with the Seed Package deployment tiers to read the world's scale.

name: activity
function: the Statistics Wall's live-play view (owner, in the Creator's Workshop)
label: activity
notes: Second read-only Creator Workshop station tool (Statistics Wall): owner-gated AND station-gated. Reflects the live session roster (players online + room/zone) without touching world state. survey reads the world's SHAPE; activity reads its LIFE.

name: create
function: the NPC Studio: stage a new NPC (owner, in the Creator's Workshop)
label: create
notes: First mutating Creator Workshop tool: stages a new NPC into the owner's session draft (create npc <name> at <room>); owner + NPC Studio gated; validates the room exists before staging.

name: preview
label: preview
notes: Lists the owner's staged, not-yet-live changes; available anywhere in the Workshop.

name: publish
function: publish staged changes to the live world (owner, at the Publishing Portal)
label: publish
notes: The single sanctioned mutation point: applies each staged change through the one validated apply-path to the LIVE in-memory world (never the seed files). Owner + Publishing Portal gated.

name: rollback
function: discard staged Creator Workshop changes (owner, at the Publishing Portal)
label: rollback
notes: Discards the owner's staged changes without publishing. Owner + Publishing Portal gated.

name: allocate
label: allocate
notes: Build agency: spend the STAT_POINTS_PER_LEVEL points a level-up grants into one of the six attributes, capped per level. Points are derived (earned-spent); the allocation folds into the StatBlock via jobs.build_stats and persists.

name: signet
function: the Maker's Signet: the Creator Interface, borne anywhere (owner)
label: signet
notes: The Creator Artifact's verb: owner-only; bare opens the Creator Interface remotely, signet <function> channels a workshop read-only tool (survey/activity) from anywhere.

name: gather
label: gather
notes: The gather verb: harvest the current room's node (a crafting material) with a per-player renewal cooldown; the non-combat source of the gather->craft loop.

name: travel
function: the Waystone network: pay to cross the world (travel [where])
label: travel
notes: The coin sink + fast-travel verb: at a zone waystone, pay a level-scaled fare to travel to any other hub.

name: feats
function: your deed ledger: the feats you have earned
label: feats
notes: The achievements/deeds panel: earned vs locked feats derived live from the character's persisted state; long-term goals + a next-deed nudge.

name: region
function: the story of the zone you stand in (its tale, depths, and work)
label: region
notes: zone_story.region_view: composes the player's current zone into a story dossier (tale + warden + inscription + landmark + cull/forage counts). The Zone Story Framework's player face.

name: weather
function: the season and sky over the world right now
label: weather
notes: climate.weather_view: the world's current season + weather, derived from the world beat. The world-simulation layer's first player face; the seam future seasonal/weather-gated spawns read.

name: factions
function: the standing between the Orders: who is allied, who is rival
label: factions
notes: factions.render_factions: the politics of the Row (each Order's allies + rivals), marking the reader's own sworn Order. The faction-conflict model over the existing Orders.

name: professions
function: your maker's trades and their levels (gathering and crafting skills)
label: professions
notes: professions.render_professions: the trade sheet. Slice 1b of the Crafting Campaign.

name: standing
function: your reputation and tier with each Order (Hostile .. Revered)
label: standing
notes: reputation.render_standing: the standing sheet. Roadmap #2.

name: route
function: the shortest on-foot path to a room, as directions (route <room>)
label: route
notes: travel.route -> navigation kernel (native Rust when built). Roadmap: polyglot slice 1.

name: condition
function: how you are right now: vital pools, what ails you, your sworn standing
label: condition
notes: condition.render_condition: the at-a-glance state view; wires the orphaned afflictions renderer. Roadmap: status view.

name: party
label: party
notes: _party_cmd dispatches to parts.world.party (invite/join/leave/disband/roster). The first shared-purpose multiplayer verb; foundation for shared combat + dungeons + raids.

name: psay
function: speak on your party's private channel (psay <message>)
label: psay
notes: party.party_say: the party-only chat channel; message case preserved by the spine (Architecture Law 7). Delivers via events.announce_to.

name: trade
function: trade goods and coin with a hero: trade <player> | accept | add <item> | coins <n> | confirm | cancel
label: trade
notes: _trade_cmd dispatches to parts.world.trade (propose/accept/add/coins/confirm/cancel/render). The first player economy verb; atomic swap on per-player inventory.

name: guild
label: guild
notes: _guild_cmd dispatches to parts.world.guild (found/invite/accept/promote/leave/disband/roster). The persisted social pillar; membership survives logout.

name: gsay
label: gsay
notes: guild.guild_say: the guild chat channel; reaches online guild-mates via events.announce_to.

name: mail
function: asynchronous letters: mail | mail send <player> <message> | mail read <n> | delete <n>
label: mail
notes: _mail_cmd dispatches to parts.world.mail (inbox/send/read/delete). The async social channel, reaching offline heroes.

name: `@script`
function: run a sandboxed Lua snippet from in-game (owner): a deny-by-default scripting console.
label: @script
notes: ADMIN verb, min_rank owner. Runs Lua in parts.scripting.LuaSandbox (no os/io/require; loops bounded). Needs the [lua] extra; says so cleanly when absent. Polyglot organ 7 (embedded scripting, ADR-0014).

name: friend
function: your friends list: friend | friend add <player> | friend remove <player>
label: friend
notes: _friend_cmd dispatches to parts.world.friends (list/add/remove). Personal, one-directional roster with online status.

name: friends
function: show your friends list and who is online (alias of `friend`)
label: friends
notes: Second verb for the friends list, both friend and friends route to _friend_cmd.

name: chat
function: speak on the world channel, heard by every hero online (chat <message>)
label: chat
notes: Routes to parts.world.chat.world_say. The world-wide live channel; the spine preserves the message case.

name: rest
function: rest at an inn's hearth to restore HP/MP/focus to full
label: rest
notes: Routes to parts.world.inns.rest. Restores every session resource to maximum, but only in an inn interior (is_inn_room); refused elsewhere. Reuses combat's heal-to-max idiom; moves no world state.

name: @maintenance
label: @maintenance
notes: _maintenance_cmd toggles parts.world.maintenance_mode and broadcasts. Owner-gated ADMIN verb. Non-staff logins refused at the front desk while on. Distinct from the CORE `maintenance` change-log verb.

name: bank
function: your personal vault: bank | bank deposit <item> | bank withdraw <n>
label: bank
notes: _bank_cmd dispatches to parts.world.bank (render/deposit/withdraw). A deposited item leaves the world into storage until withdrawn; survives logout via the loose_items table.

name: auction
function: the marketplace: auction | auction list <item> <price> | auction buy <#>
label: auction
notes: _auction_cmd dispatches to parts.world.auction (browse/list_item/buy). Listing escrows an item out of the world; buying pays the seller and re-clones it to the buyer; unsold items are mailed back on expiry.

name: @audit
label: @audit
notes: _audit_cmd shows recent audit entries or, with 'verify', checks the hash chain. Owner-gated ADMIN verb.

name: @ban
label: @ban
notes: Moderation verb over parts.world.bans; audited.

name: @unban
label: @unban
notes: Moderation verb over parts.world.bans; audited.

name: @bans
label: @bans
notes: Moderation verb over parts.world.bans; audited.

name: @metrics
function: a live-ops snapshot from storage: population + economy health (owner)
label: @metrics
notes: _metrics_cmd renders parts.world.metrics.snapshot for a live admin.

name: mend
function: mend your worn gear for coins (the economy's repair sink)
label: mend
notes: Routes to parts.world.durability.repair_session: fully repairs all equipped gear for coins (REPAIR_COST_PER_POINT per point of wear), the economy's coin sink against inflation. Refuses loud (charges nothing) when the purse is short or nothing is worn. Distinct from CMD-04.050 'repair' (the Engineer's field self-heal).

name: tutorial
function: the guided next step for a new hero (onboarding)
label: tutorial
notes: Routes to parts.world.tutorial.next_step: the state-driven onboarding ladder. Any hero can call it at any stage; a brand-new hero is also nudged toward it on first login (gateway greeting).

function: take the boon of this room's wayshrine
label: pray
name: pray
notes: The pray verb: take a wayshrine boon (restores a share of HP/MP/power) with a per-player renewal cooldown; the non-combat rest stop of a journey.
